name: _meta
script: return "照片级收藏与标签（亮色）：照片墙悬停收藏 → 灯箱收藏 → 标签编辑弹层保存 → 信息栏标签 chips → 只看收藏/标签过滤 → ⌘K 照片标签徽章 → 设为封面（徽标迁移 + 时间线堆叠首图立即生效）。前置：gen-demo 演示数据。"

name: 02-open-trip
script: const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('京都')); if (!h) throw new Error('找不到京都'); h.click(); 'ok'

name: 04-fav-photo1
script: const b = document.querySelector('button[title="收藏"]'); if (!b) throw new Error('找不到收藏按钮'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 06-open-lightbox
script: const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('main img'); if (imgs.length < 2) throw new Error('照片墙图片不足'); imgs[1].click(); 'ok'

name: 08-lightbox-fav
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[title="收藏"]')].pop(); if (!b) throw new Error('灯箱收藏按钮缺失'); b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); if (![...document.querySelectorAll('button[title="取消收藏"]')].length) throw new Error('灯箱收藏状态未更新'); 'fav-ok'

name: 09-open-tag-editor
script: window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'i' })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const b = document.querySelector('button[title="编辑标签"]'); if (!b) throw new Error('信息面板编辑标签按钮缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 11-tag-save
script: const inp = document.querySelector('input[placeholder^="给这张照片加标签"]'); if (!inp) throw new Error('标签输入缺失'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(inp, '雪山, 黄昏'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 150)); const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '保存'); if (!b) throw new Error('保存按钮缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 12-lightbox-tagged
script: if (!document.body.textContent.includes('#雪山')) throw new Error('灯箱信息栏未见标签'); 'ok'

name: 15-fav-filter
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.includes('只看收藏')); if (!b) throw new Error('只看收藏 chip 缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 17-clear-filter
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.includes('清除')); if (!b) throw new Error('清除按钮缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 18-tag-filter
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '#雪山'); if (!b) throw new Error('#雪山 chip 缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 20-clear-tag
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.includes('清除')); if (!b) throw new Error('清除按钮缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 22-type-query
script: const inp = document.querySelector('input[placeholder^="搜索旅行标题"]'); if (!inp) throw new Error('搜索输入缺失'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(inp, '雪山'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); 'ok'

name: 23-search-phototag
script: const badge = [...document.querySelectorAll('span')].find(s => s.textContent.trim() === '照片标签'); if (!badge) throw new Error('未命中照片标签徽章'); 'ok'

name: 24-esc-cmdk
script: window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); 'ok'

name: 25-set-cover
script: const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=photo-wall] > div')].filter(el => el.querySelector('img')); if (cards.length < 2) throw new Error('照片墙卡片不足'); const target = cards[1]; if (target.textContent.includes('封面')) throw new Error('目标卡已是封面，用例前提不成立'); const star = target.querySelector('button[title="设为封面"]'); if (!star) throw new Error('设为封面按钮缺失'); star.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); if (!target.textContent.includes('封面')) throw new Error('封面徽标未迁移到目标卡'); const firstCard = cards[0]; if (firstCard.textContent.includes('封面')) throw new Error('原封面卡仍带徽标'); window.__coverSrc = target.querySelector('img').src; 'cover-set: ' + window.__coverSrc

name: 26-back-timeline
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '返回'); if (!b) throw new Error('返回按钮缺失'); b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('京都')); if (!h) throw new Error('找不到京都'); const card = h.closest('.relative.flex'); if (!card) throw new Error('旅行卡片缺失'); const first = card.querySelector('.polaroid-frame img'); if (!first) throw new Error('时间线堆叠首图缺失'); if (first.src !== window.__coverSrc) throw new Error('时间线堆叠首图未跟随封面: ' + first.src + ' vs ' + window.__coverSrc); 'timeline-cover-ok'
